character_sheet: The Leonopteryx is the canonical registry of Leon, the tameable, rideable flying lion-dragon — one EntityLeon class behind both ids, `leon` the save-compat alias (ModEntities.java:530-547); this sheet and `leon`'s describe the same rig and code. The rig is a chest and abdomen, a three-segment neck to a crested head with an upper and a lower jaw, three sails above and three below the jaws, eye ridges and two-piece antennae, two-segment arms each carrying two wing panels, three-finger wing fans with claws at their tips, a broad back panel and a long tail-fin strip a side, and two-segment legs with feet — every part twice over, one skeleton for standing and one for flight (LeonModel.createBodyLayer, LeonModel.java:257-751; standingParts / flyingParts :233-255; one set visible per frame, :774-776). It has 250 HP and 55 attack (createAttributes, EntityLeon.java:231-238; four times that against the Kraken, and 55 through the Ender Dragon's parts, doHurtTarget :431-461, knockback 1.25). Standing it wanders, follows its owner, is tempted by beef and looks about (goals :153-158) and takes to the air when it finds prey or on a rare roll (alwaysDo :594-630); flying it steers itself to a flight target, hunts monsters — and players while untamed — on a 1-in-8 roll and bites within 7 blocks plus half the target's width (flyWithoutRider :633-797), a tamed one fleeing when below a quarter health (:704-712). A diamond block tames it at once and beef one time in three; an item sits and stands it, a dead bush untames it, an empty hand mounts it (mobInteract :871-962); ridden, it flies on the client-predicted RiderFlightController (:97-108, tickRidden :346-352) and bites for its rider within 9 blocks (flyWithRider :556-578). Being hurt wakes it into flight and turns it on the attacker (hurt :464-484). It spawns by day above y 50 on a 1-in-16 dice with no other Leon within 48 blocks (checkSpawnRules :976-985); the Chaos biome lists `leon` (chaos_biome.json). Read it as two creatures on one rig: a heavy walker, and a wide-winged flyer whose whole body pumps with the beat.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.75 of the rig (LeonRenderer.java:29, applied :38-39; shadow 1.75) on a 256x256 sheet (LeonModel.java:751); 3.5 x 8.25 block hitbox (ModEntities.java:542-547, both registries). The rig carries both skeletons (98 bones: 49 standing, 49 flight-form with an f prefix); the code shows one set per frame by the synced activity byte and hides the other (LeonModel.java:774-776) — a standing clip keys the plain bones, a flight clip the f bones.

groups.name: gait
groups.axis: x (the legs, arms and wing panels), y (the back panels)
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) x the walking speed above a 0.1 threshold (zero below it): the thighs about ∓0.611 rad (left +, right −), the shins about ±0.611 with the feet placed along the chain; the upper arms and root wing panels at half of it about −0.07 / −0.17, the forearms and second panels at half about −0.471 / −0.523; the back panels at a tenth about ±0.523
groups.plain: standing, the legs stride with the walking speed, the arms and the two wing panels a side swing half as far with them, and the broad back panels sway a tenth
groups.math: a = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.8 * 0.22) * pi * 0.25 * amount : 0; leg_1_L.xRot = -0.611 + a, leg_1_R.xRot = -0.611 - a; leg_2_L.xRot = 0.611 + a, leg_2_R.xRot = 0.611 - a (feet by position); wing_3_R.yRot = 0.523 - a/10, wing_3_L.yRot = -0.523 - a/10; arm_1_L.xRot = -0.07 - a/2, arm_1_R.xRot = -0.07 + a/2; wing_1_L/R.xRot = -0.17 -/+ a/2; arm_2_L/R.xRot = -0.471 -/+ a/2; wing_2_L/R.xRot = -0.523 -/+ a/2 (positions along the chain)

behaviour: Two skeletons on one rig: the standing parts and the flight parts (f-prefixed) are both in the geo, and the code shows exactly one set per frame by the synced DATA_ACTIVITY byte — 0 standing, else flying (LeonModel.java:774-776; EntityLeon.java:82-83, :261-268). No animation channel expresses that visibility: how the two skeletons are toggled under GeckoLib is a seam decision for when the rig lands (§5.2).

Standing (activity 0): one speed-scaled stride at 0.396 rad/tick (a 15.9-tick period) above a walking-speed threshold of 0.1 — the thighs swing 45 degrees each way about their rests with the shins and feet placed along them, the arms and the two wing panels a side swing half of it, the back panels sway a tenth (LeonModel.java:761-766, :778-799, :813-816). The wing fans fold at a slower 0.198 rad/tick: a half, a quarter and an eighth of the stride when walking, a 3.6-degree breath when still, nothing while sitting (:763-769, :800-812, :817-829). A 0.132 rad/tick breath rocks the chest an eighth and the lower jaw and its sails a half of 3.6 degrees (:830-835); the head, crest, eye ridges, antennae and lower jaw turn half the look yaw (:836-850).

Flying (activity 1): the beat is 0.352 rad/tick (a 17.9-tick period), 1.7 times faster and 1.4 times wider while the attacking flag is set (:852-855). The chest pitches an eighth of a 10.8-degree wave and rises and falls 10 units with it unless ridden (:856-860); the upper arms and root panels beat 47 degrees about the body's long axis, the forearms and second panels 1.3 times that, the three fan fingers 1.65 times, fanned at 45, 67 and 90 degrees (:925-969); the neck pitches against the beat segment by segment and the head with its parts rides the chain (:970-1008); the tail-fin strips pitch a tenth (:877-878).

Flying and not attacking the legs hang tucked and still; attacking they reach forward and paddle at 0.792 rad/tick — 18 degrees on the thighs, 27 on the shins, 36 on the feet (:879-924) — and the lower jaw snaps 29 degrees at 0.572 rad/tick about a −0.9 rest instead of breathing (:1048-1056). The head turns half the look yaw, or, ridden, a filtered turn rate clamped to ±50 degrees (:1009-1044).

The takeoff and the landing are flag flips (alwaysDo, EntityLeon.java:594-630; hurt :469; mobInteract :943, :955), the bite is doHurtTarget (:431-461) from the flight AI (:721) or the ridden auto-melee (:573), and the wing sound every 20 ticks in flight (:494-503) is the entity's — none of these are animation events.

wishlist: in `fly`: a real wing-beat with the body rising on the downstroke — the code already lifts the chest 10 units with the beat (LeonModel.java:859); keep that and add the neck and tail-fin follow-through it lacks
in `walk`: a heavy stride — the code swings the thighs 45 degrees (:778-780) but never shifts the chest; add a chest roll and a head bob so the weight reads
in `attack`: the bite with the jaw snapping (the attacking jaw wave, :1051-1052) and a forward lunge; the bite lands within 7 blocks plus half the target's width (EntityLeon.java:719-722)
in `aggro_idle`: the paddling legs and the faster beat the code shows while attacking (:852-855, :902-923), made to read as a dive rather than a hover
future: a visibility switch between the standing and flight skeletons — the code toggles `.visible` by DATA_ACTIVITY (LeonModel.java:774-776); no animation channel expresses that, so the seam needs a ruling on how the two skeletons are shown (a scale-to-zero key on the hidden set, or a code toggle) before a flight-form clip can play beside a standing one
locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 LeonModel row (geckolib_migration_design.md:442): 'Active-form head/fhead [2,1.8] @1; chest/fchest [3,3] @0.5; abdomen/fabdomen [2.5,2.5] @0.5; upper/lower legs/feet [1,2.5] @0.5; structural wing roots [4,1] @0.25' — 'Only the active normal/f* skeleton receives parts'. head, fhead, chest, fchest, abdomen and fabdomen resolve as written. 'upper/lower legs/feet' is not a bone name: taken as both skeletons' thighs, shins and feet — leg_1_L/R, leg_2_L/R, footL/R and fleg_1_L/R, fleg_2_L/R, ffootL/R (LeonModel.createBodyLayer :406-433, :651-678). 'structural wing roots' is not a bone name: taken as the root wing panel a side on each skeleton — wing_1_L/R and fwing_1_L/R (the panel posed with the upper arm at the shoulder, :794-795 / :928-929); the arms (arm_1_*, farm_1_*) and the outer panels and fans stay visual. Both registries (leon, leonopteryx) carry the same list: 'Separate equal-size registry profiles, one server-fed form/flight pose'.
